rows.notes: checkpoint-b.test.js P0-8: crossed taker/taker orders ($101 taker buy vs $99 taker sell) rest on the book and clear to numFills=0 with no fills; crossed maker/maker orders ($101 maker buy vs $99 maker sell) likewise clear to numFills=0; both batches settle with every portfolio flat and collateral equal to the independent Fraction reference model. Evidence: checkpoint-b-report-20141.json checkpointB.p0_8.

checkpoint-b.test.js P0-11: cancel-first ordering cancels the order (reservation released, book order removed, cancelled order id produces no fill) and a replacement order settles; clear-first ordering rejects the cancel with 602 while Cleared and the cleared fills settle exactly once (maker long 200 lots matches the model); cancelling another user's portfolio rejects 7 and another user's order id rejects 201, both unchanged; direct matcher CancelResting and CancelSettledOrders with an arbitrary user reject unchanged. Evidence: checkpoint-b-report-20101.json checkpointB.p0_11.

smoke.test.js integrityRejections: portfolio exposure limit 10 SOL (error 608), market exposure limit 50 SOL per side (609), and withdrawal cannot spend oracle loss or position IM all reject unchanged at post; every settleScenario settles without a margin rejection. checkpoint-b.test.js P0-14 adds the over-5x case: the candidate instrument caps leverage at 5x (maxLeverage=5); a 6,000-lot post at $100 (6 SOL notional against 1 SOL collateral, 6x) rejects at post with InsufficientFunds (4) and all accounts unchanged, while a 4,000-lot (4x) control posts and cancels cleanly. Evidence: runtime-report.json; checkpoint-b-report-20151.json checkpointB.p0_14.

smoke.test.js: withdrawal globally blocked while cleared rejects unchanged, and withdrawalResumedAfterSettlement=true after settle. Evidence: runtime-report.json integrityRejections[withdrawal globally blocked while cleared].

smoke.test.js oracleBoundaries: exactly 60 s and 1 percent accepted; 61 s (114), above 1 percent (210), future timestamp (114), inactive, foreign instrument, foreign owner, zero price, negative confidence, foreign oracle key and invalid header all block settlement; stale settlement reverts with all protected account bytes and lamports unchanged, oracle worker no_quorum leaves the oracle untouched, then healthy recovery publishes and settle succeeds. Evidence: runtime-report.json oracleBoundaries, rejectedSettlement, oracleWorkerRecovery.

checkpoint-b.test.js P0-17: healthy (model health 111,111,112) and health exactly 0 at $90 liquidations reject 110 unchanged; an underfunded liquidator rejects 4 on the second 25% step with the order cancellation rolled back; the funded takeover follows takeover_scenario.py steps [250, 187], victim keeps 563 lots, liquidator takes 437 lots at $85, 1% + 1% penalties match model collateral and fund exactly, victim book orders and reservations are cancelled, and vault lamports are unchanged (value conserved). Evidence: checkpoint-b-report-20111.json checkpointB.p0_17.

checkpoint-b.test.js P0-18: the loser loses 4,000,000,000 lamports of value against 201,000,000 lamports of collateral; the fund absorbs the shortfall (fund 20,000,778,792 -> 16,202,278,792), uncovered debt stays 0, no pause flags, winner credited in full, and chain collateral/fund/vault match the independent model exactly. Evidence: checkpoint-b-report-20121.json checkpointB.p0_18.

checkpoint-b.test.js P0-19: six signed settlements per direction reproduce the issue #8 conversion drift exactly: -757,575 lamports for $110 then $120 and +757,577 for the reverse, with taker fees separated through the model's own fee ledger and chain fund equal to the independent model fund after every settlement. Evidence: checkpoint-b-report-20121.json checkpointB.p0_19.

smoke.test.js: maker closes at a profit against a third trader, withdraws the full profit while the original loser still holds -1000 lots, loser position unchanged afterwards. Evidence: runtime-report.json settlementScenarios[winner withdrew profit before the loser closed].

smoke.test.js exhaustion scenario: uncovered bad debt recorded, fund exhausted to 0, pause flags=3, winner withdrawal and new exposure reject while paused (602), unpause refused with debt outstanding and with one lamport of debt (612), inflows repay debt before the fund, trading cannot resume before withdrawals, withdrawals resume first and the winner then withdraws in full. Evidence: runtime-report.json settlementScenarios[exhaustion..trading resumed].

smoke.test.js: risk-off post below 0.4 x open interest rejects unchanged (610) while reduce-only closes and withdrawals still simulate accepted. Evidence: runtime-report.json integrityRejections[risk-off].

smoke.test.js: permissionless signed TopUp moves real lamports into the fund; fund withdrawal above the surplus rejects (611), fund withdrawal by a non-governance signer rejects (7), governance withdraws exactly the surplus leaving the fund at the required reserve. Evidence: runtime-report.json settlementScenarios[fund withdrawn down to the required reserve].
smoke.test.js: missing portfolio, duplicate portfolio and malformed portfolio count settlements all reject with every integrity account unchanged. Evidence: runtime-report.json integrityRejections.
smoke.test.js: re-clear rejected, wrong batch result rejected, spent result replay rejected, settled batch replay rejected, all unchanged. Evidence: runtime-report.json integrityRejections.

checkpoint-b.test.js P0-26: twelve orders from twelve portfolios fill the 12-fill results cap (60 lots matched) and all twelve portfolios settle in ONE SettleBatch transaction; every position (plus/minus 10 lots) and lamport balance matches the independent model, the batch is Settled and the results are spent. Evidence: checkpoint-b-report-20131.json checkpointB.p0_26.
